title: reverseproxy: Only retry responses for expressions that use response data
author: jayhemnani9910

spotlights.label: An OR with a response placeholder still retries
spotlights.why: The check is per matcher set, not per clause. `{http.request.method} == "POST" || {rp.status_code} == 502` reads response data, so it is still evaluated against every response and still retries every successful POST.

spotlights.label: Response placeholders are a hand-kept list
spotlights.why: Only status_code, status_text, upstream.latency, upstream.latency_ms and header.* count. A response placeholder added to reverseProxy later must also be added here, or expressions that use it silently stop retrying responses.

spotlights.label: Response retries of a POST still send no body
spotlights.why: Unchanged by this PR: without request_buffers the body is read by the first attempt, so a retried POST goes out empty (the issue shows it). The response-retry tests only use GET. Reasoned from the code, not run.

steps.title: Record the placeholders an expression reads
steps.why: While provisioning, MatchExpression walks its checked CEL AST and keeps the name passed to every ph() call; `{x}` is already expanded to `ph(req, "x")` by then. A name that is not a string literal is kept as "". Placeholders() hands out a copy.
steps.consequence: Every provisioned expression knows which placeholders it reads. Nothing uses it yet.

notes: Walks the checked AST, not the text
Copy: callers cannot mutate shared state

steps.title: Retry a response only when the expression reads it
steps.why: After the round trip, reverseProxy used to evaluate every retry_match set holding any expression. matcherSetReferencesResponse now evaluates a set only if one of its expressions reads status_code, status_text, upstream.latency(_ms), a header.* placeholder, or a name unknown until evaluation.
steps.consequence: A request-only expression is a request condition again, as before v2.11.3: a 200 is passed through. tryAgain, which decides retries after transport errors, is untouched.

notes: One response placeholder flags the set

steps.title: Prove both forms retry and request-only ones do not
steps.why: TestResponseRetryStatusCode now runs both `{http.reverse_proxy.status_code}` and the direct `ph(req, ...)` form. The new TestRequestOnlyExpressionDoesNotRetryResponses POSTs through two healthy upstreams with four expressions that must not retry.
steps.consequence: The issue case, a selection-time placeholder, an escaped placeholder in a string and a misspelt name are each hit once with a 200.

notes: Escaped: a string, not a placeholder
